meta.name: Firmware Commit
meta.description: Used to modify the firmware image or Boot Partitions.

CNS.desc: Firmware Slot (FS) or Boot Partition ID (BPID)

BootPartitionID.desc: Specifies the Boot Partition that shall be used for the Commit Action, if applicable.

CommitAction.desc: This field specifies the action that is taken on the image downloaded with the Firmware Image Download command or on a previously downloaded and placed image.

FirmwareSlot.desc: Specifies the firmware slot that shall be used for the Commit Action, if applicable. If the value specified is 0h, then the controller shall choose the firmware slot (i.e., slot 1 to slot 7) to use for the operation.
